title: Viracocha and Lake Titicaca as a mirror civilization of Lake Van
summary: Matt tells of Viracocha and Lake Titicaca as a mirror civilization of Lake Van, about pre-Tiwanaku at Lake Titicaca, Tiwanaku, Puma Punku, Bolivia/Peru, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Lake Titicaca, Tiwanaku, Puma Punku, Bolivia/Peru

tellings.quote: Bolivia we have vosha holding the two Condors on either side which I think is the same concept you see in front of you of the pillars of holding balance

plain: A researcher named Matt, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast about ancient history, compared sites around Lake Titicaca on the border of Bolivia and Peru, including the ruins of Tiwanaku and Puma Punku, with the region of Lake Van. He says that in Bolivia there is an image of Viracocha, a creator god of the Andes, holding two condors on either side, which he sees as the same idea as pillars holding balance found at the other site. He tells it to suggest the two places were mirror civilisations sharing one older source.
